description.html: The 10 cm magnetic glass cleaner is the larger version of the Resun Magnetic Brush (marked Medium on the pack). Its bigger working surface cleans the glass in fewer strokes, so it suits medium and larger aquariums, where a small cleaner would be slow.

The cleaner has two parts held together by a magnet. The inner part goes into the water against the glass, and you guide it with the outer part along the outside. This removes thin algae films without getting your hands wet and without disturbing the fish.

Clean regularly, while the film is still thin. Be careful near the bottom: a grain of sand or gravel trapped under the inner part can scratch the glass, so take the cleaner out and rinse it. After use, rinse both parts with clean water and store them together. For stubborn deposits and corners use a scraper or sponge, and use the regular cleaning as a chance to check on the fish and equipment.
